top_contexts.title: 台灣勞動基準法_公開資料測試.docx | 勞動契約終止與預告
top_contexts.content:
第 11 條列出雇主得預告終止勞動契約的事由，包括歇業或轉讓、虧損或業務緊縮、不可抗力暫停工作一個月以上、業務性質變更且必須減少勞工而無適當工作可安置，以及勞工確不能勝任所擔任工作。

第 15 條規定，不定期契約的勞工終止契約時，應準用第 16 條第一項所定期間預告雇主。

第 16 條規定預告期間：繼續工作三個月以上、一年未滿者，應在十日前預告；繼續工作一年以上、三年未滿者，應在二十日前預告；繼續工作三年以上者，應在三十日前預告。

勞工接到終止契約預告後，為另謀工作可在工作時間請假外出，每星期不得超過二日的工作時間，請假期間工資照給。雇主未依法定期間預告而終止契約時，應給付預告期間工資。

第 17 條規定，雇主依第 16 條終止勞動契約時，應依法發給資遣費，並應於終止勞動契約後三十日內發給。

top_contexts.title: 台灣勞動基準法_公開資料測試.docx | 工作時間
top_contexts.content:
第 30 條規定，勞工正常工作時間每日不得超過八小時，每週不得超過四十小時。

雇主應置備勞工出勤紀錄並保存五年。出勤紀錄應逐日記載至分鐘，勞工申請副本或影本時，雇主不得拒絕。

第 32 條規定，延長工作時間連同正常工作時間，一日不得超過十二小時。延長工作時間原則上一個月不得超過四十六小時；符合法定同意程序時，一個月不得超過五十四小時，且每三個月不得超過一百三十八小時。

top_contexts.title: 台灣勞動基準法_公開資料測試.docx | 工資規定
top_contexts.content:
第 21 條規定工資由勞雇雙方議定，但不得低於基本工資。

第 22 條規定工資原則上應以法定通用貨幣給付，並應全額直接給付勞工；法律另有規定或勞雇雙方另有約定者除外。

第 23 條要求雇主提供工資各項目計算方式明細，並置備工資清冊；工資清冊應保存五年。

第 24 條規定延長工作時間的加班工資標準。延長工作時間在二小時以內者，按平日每小時工資額加給三分之一以上；再延長二小時以內者，加給三分之二以上。

answer.text:
依照勞動基準法，繼續工作一年以上但未滿三年，終止契約應提前二十天預告。

top_contexts.title: NASA_Mars_2020_Public_Data_Test.docx | Surface operations
top_contexts.content:
A Martian day is called a sol and lasts 24 hours, 39 minutes, and 35.244 seconds. The planned prime mission lasted one Martian year, equal to about 687 Earth days or 669 sols.

Perseverance was designed to drive on average about 650 feet, or 200 meters, per Martian day. Much of its driving operation was automated to streamline navigation around rocks and sand traps.

The Ingenuity Mars Helicopter traveled to Mars attached beneath Perseverance. Its flight-test program was a technology demonstration for powered, controlled flight on another planet.

top_contexts.title: NASA_Mars_2020_Public_Data_Test.docx | Launch and cruise
top_contexts.content:
The spacecraft launched aboard a United Launch Alliance Atlas V 541 rocket at 7:50 a.m. EDT on July 30, 2020.

The interplanetary cruise required 203 days to travel about 293 million miles, or 471 million kilometers, from Earth to Mars. The final 45 days formed the approach subphase.

During cruise, engineers checked spacecraft subsystems and instruments and prepared trajectory correction maneuvers so the vehicle would reach its target at the top of the Martian atmosphere.

top_contexts.title: NASA_Mars_2020_Public_Data_Test.docx | Entry, descent, and landing
top_contexts.content:
The entry, descent, and landing phase began at roughly 12,100 miles per hour, or 19,500 kilometers per hour, and ended about seven minutes later on the Martian surface.

Jezero Crater is a 28-mile-wide, or 45-kilometer-wide, impact basin containing an ancient river delta, steep cliffs, sand dunes, boulder fields, and smaller impact craters.

Two new landing technologies made the challenging Jezero target possible: Range Trigger and Terrain-Relative Navigation. Range Trigger adjusted parachute deployment timing based on the spacecraft's navigation position. Terrain-Relative Navigation used onboard imagery and computing to estimate position and choose a reachable safe landing target.

answer.text:
毅力號從地球到火星的巡航約花了203天，距離約471百萬公里。

top_contexts.title: NASA_Mars_2020_Public_Data_Test.docx | Mission overview
top_contexts.content:
NASA's Mars 2020 spacecraft carried the Perseverance rover. It launched from Cape Canaveral, Florida, on July 30, 2020, and arrived at Mars on February 18, 2021.

The mission phases were launch, interplanetary cruise, entry-descent-landing, and surface operations.

Perseverance explores Jezero Crater. Its key astrobiology objective is to search for signs of ancient microbial life. It also studies Mars' climate and geology, supports preparation for future human exploration, and collects and caches Martian rock and regolith.
